rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that an action may happen, such as possibly going somewhere.

example.jyutping: ngo5 ting1 jat6 ho2 nang4 wui5 lok6 jyu5

rows.jyutping: seoi1 jin4 A daan6 hai6 B
rows.note: Use this to concede that A is true before stressing the contrasting point B.

example.english: Although today is cold, I might still have to go to work.
example.traditional: 雖然今日好凍，但係我可能都要返工。
example.jyutping: seoi1 jin4 gam1 jat6 hou2 dung3 daan6 hai6 ngo5 ho2 nang4 dou1 jiu3 faan1 gung1

rows.note: Use this for the more hypothetical or emphatic sense of “even if A, B.”

example.english: Even if it rains tomorrow, I might still go hiking.
example.traditional: 就算聽日落雨，我都會去行山。
example.jyutping: zau6 syun3 ting1 jat6 lok6 jyu5 ngo5 dou1 wui5 heoi3 haang4 saan1
